Potato Wedges
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 12:06am

Ingredients




Unpeeled potatoes
1/2 cup oil
2 tablespoons grated Parmesan cheese
1 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon each garlic powder and paprika
1/4 teaspoon pepper

Preparation

1 Slice potatoes into 1/2 inch thick wedges. 2 Combine ingredients and brush over potato wedges. Arrange potatoes peel side down. Bake at 375 degrees for 45 minutes. Brush potatoes occasionally with oil mixture.
